SELECT 1 FROM sportovci s WHERE s.id=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM coach_scope_grants g JOIN treneri cg_t ON cg_t.id=g.trainer_id AND cg_t.aktivni=1 JOIN staff_user_positions cg_p ON cg_p.trainer_id=g.trainer_id AND cg_p.position_code='coach' WHERE g.trainer_id=7 AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.valid_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((g.scope_kind='team' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM club_roster_members cm JOIN club_teams ct ON ct.id=cm.team_id WHERE cm.sportovec_id=s.id AND cm.team_id=g.scope_id AND cm.status='active' AND ct.status='active' AND cm.valid_from<=CURRENT_DATE AND (cm.valid_to IS NULL OR cm.valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE)))))

SELECT BINARY mz.typ AS typ,COUNT(*) AS num,MIN(ordinal) AS first_position FROM (SELECT mz.id AS mereni_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t.datum DESC,t.id DESC,tm.poradi ASC,mz.id ASC) AS ordinal FROM trenink_mereni tm JOIN mereni_zaznamy mz ON mz.id=tm.mereni_id JOIN treninky t ON t.id=tm.trenink_id WHERE mz.sportovec_id=?) ordered_types JOIN mereni_zaznamy mz ON mz.id=ordered_types.mereni_id GROUP BY BINARY mz.typ ORDER BY first_position

SELECT tm.trenink_id,tm.poradi,mz.id AS mereni_id,mz.typ, mz.vzdalenost,mz.distance_unit,mz.cas,mz.prevod,mz.cvik_id,mz.segment_id, mz.vaha,mz.opakovani,mz.rpe,mz.poznamka AS mereni_poznamka, c.nazev AS cvik_nazev,seg.nazev AS segment_nazev,tm.trenink_datum FROM (SELECT tm.trenink_id,tm.poradi,tm.mereni_id,t.datum AS trenink_datum FROM (SELECT id FROM treninky ORDER BY datum DESC,id DESC LIMIT 64) recent STRAIGHT_JOIN treninky t ON t.id=recent.id STRAIGHT_JOIN trenink_mereni tm ON tm.trenink_id=t.id STRAIGHT_JOIN mereni_zaznamy mz ON mz.id=tm.mereni_id WHERE mz.sportovec_id=? ORDER BY t.datum DESC,t.id DESC,tm.poradi ASC,mz.id ASC LIMIT 25 OFFSET 0) tm JOIN mereni_zaznamy mz ON mz.id=tm.mereni_id LEFT JOIN cviky c ON c.id=mz.cvik_id LEFT JOIN segmenty seg ON seg.id=mz.segment_id WHERE mz.sportovec_id=? ORDER BY tm.trenink_datum DESC,tm.trenink_id DESC,tm.poradi ASC,mz.id ASC
